Bug Title / Summary: Unhandled 500 Internal Server Error & Entity Leak on Invalid Sort Query Parameter
Root Cause: Spring Data JPA throws unhandled PropertyReferenceException; leaks 'AttendanceStatusThresholdMaster' entity name
Fix Recommendation: Add @ExceptionHandler(PropertyReferenceException.class) in @ControllerAdvice and return 400 Bad Request

Bug Title / Summary: Missing Input Validation for Special-Character-Only Values in Threshold Name (Accepted quotes-only Name)
Root Cause: DTO lacks regex pattern validation on thresholdName; persists quotes-only string

Bug Title / Summary: Missing Chronological Date Order Validation Allows Inverted Effective Date Range (effectiveTo earlier than effectiveFrom)
Root Cause: Service layer lacks effectiveTo.isBefore(effectiveFrom) check on employee assignments
Fix Recommendation: Validate effectiveTo >= effectiveFrom before saving in WeekOffService

Bug Title / Summary: Missing Assignment De-Duplication Validation Allows Duplicate Employee Entries (Calculation Fan-Out Defect)
Root Cause: Service layer fails to enforce unique employeeId in assignments list; creates duplicate assignment rows
Fix Recommendation: Add HashSet uniqueness validation for employeeId before persisting assignments

Bug Title / Summary: Missing 24-Hour Upper Bound Limit Validation on Threshold Working Hours (Accepted > 24 Hours: 50.00h)
Root Cause: DTO lacks @DecimalMax(value = '24.00') validation on absentMaxHours, halfDayMinHours, fullDayMinHours, presentMinHours
Fix Recommendation: Add @DecimalMin(value = '0.00') and @DecimalMax(value = '24.00') constraint annotations across all threshold hour fields

Bug Title / Summary: Missing Input Validation for Special-Character-Only Values in Policy Name (Accepted quotes-only Name)
Root Cause: DTO lacks regex pattern validation on policyName; persists quotes-only string

Bug Title / Summary: Unhandled 500 Internal Server Error & JPA Entity Leak on Invalid Sort Query Parameter
Root Cause: Spring Data JPA throws unhandled PropertyReferenceException; leaks 'LateEarlyPolicyMaster' entity name
Fix Recommendation: Add @ExceptionHandler(PropertyReferenceException.class) in @ControllerAdvice and return 400 Bad Request

Bug Title / Summary: Missing Status Cascade on Policy Deactivation Leaves Child Employee Assignments Active (Cascade Desynchronization)
Root Cause: Service layer changes parent isActive = 'N' but omits cascading update to assignments and priorities tables
Fix Recommendation: In changeStatus(), execute cascade update: assignmentRepository.updateStatusByPolicyId(policyId, newStatus)
